risk_if_not_implemented: Without Suspicious Communications & Anomalous System Behavior, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), Lack of a security-minded workforce (R-SA-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to provide all employees and contractors appropriate security, compliance and resilience awareness education and training that is relevant for their job function.
compensating_control_1.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training (SAT-04) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Suspicious Communications & Anomalous System Behavior (SAT-06.2) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to provide role-based security, compliance and resilience-related training: 
(1) Before authorizing access to the system or performing assigned duties; 
(2) When required by system changes; and 
(3) Annually thereafter.
compensating_control_2.justification: Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training (SAT-05) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Suspicious Communications & Anomalous System Behavior (SAT-06.2) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
